articles.t: GTA 6 provoque des pics de trafic chez des fournisseurs d’accès à Internet
articles.chapeau: Disponible en France depuis ce jeudi, GTA 6 a fait exploser le trafic Internet chez l'ensemble des fournisseurs d'accès
articles.txt:
La sortie de GTA 6 se mesure déjà sur les réseaux Internet français. Ce jeudi, treize ans après le précédent volet de Grand Theft Auto , les joueurs peuvent découvrir le jeu de Rockstar depuis minuit . Tous doivent le télécharger, même ceux qui l’ont acheté en magasin, puisque la boîte contient un code.
Chez Bouygues Telecom , les téléchargements de GTA 6 ont représenté jusqu’à 40 % du trafic en journée, « soit davantage que Netflix et YouTube réunis », selon Jérôme Latrille, directeur technique et plan réseau de l’opérateur. Dans la nuit de mercredi à jeudi, Bouygues Telecom a enregistré « un pic de trafic jamais atteint sur notre réseau, avec une hausse de 10 % par rapport aux jours habituellement les plus chargés, le dimanche notamment ».
Chez Orange , les téléchargements ont contribué à deux records de trafic, le 12 novembre lors de la mise en vente du jeu en boutique, puis mercredi soir, « avec un pic atteint à 22 heures ». Free a relevé un pic supérieur à celui de la semaine précédente, mais « cela n’a pas entraîné de difficultés notables ». SFR a également signalé « une pointe de trafic » mercredi, « sans impact » sur son réseau.
Take-Two Interactive, maison mère de Rockstar, n’a pas encore communiqué ses chiffres de ventes. Selon le cabinet Sensor Tower, les précommandes ont dépassé 19 millions d’exemplaires et généré plus de 1,8 milliard de dollars. Visibrain a recensé plus de 2,6 millions de messages sur les réseaux sociaux en 24 heures à l’occasion de la sortie mondiale, davantage que pour le lancement de la Coupe du monde de football 2026.

articles.t: GTA 6 Leak: CyberLeek Claims 209 GB Xbox Build Is Out
articles.chapeau: CyberLeek claims to have shared a 209 GB Xbox build of GTA 6 on launch day. The leaker says the missing executable will follow when a countdown ends.
articles.txt:
CyberLeek has returned, claiming to leak a 209GB GTA 6 Xbox build, but withheld the executable. They’re demanding crypto funding, so skepticism—and avoiding payment—is strongly advised.
On October 14, CyberLeek signed off with a three-part statement titled The End of the Road. “The leeks stop here. For now.” Turns out “for now” meant 36 days. It’s GTA 6 launch day and CyberLeek is back, claiming to have released a November Xbox build of the game via torrent. The download reportedly weighs in at 209 GB. The one file CyberLeek says they’ve kept to themselves is the executable you’d need to actually run the thing.
Aside from the executable, the download seems real and does seem to be the game files, at least according to people who have already jumped on and checked it all out. Obviously, I won’t be linking to the files here.
According to a statement attributed to CyberLeek and reproduced on Reddit, the executable will be released when a countdown hits zero. That countdown will end on November. There is, of course, a way to speed that up, because of course there is. If the leaker’s cryptocurrency reaches a $15 million market cap, they say they’ll release the file immediately. “30 million was too ambitious; half that seems fair,” reads the statement.
This seems utterly stupid. Why pay a bunch of money to this CyberLeek entity if they are already saying they’ll give you the missing file in 4 days anyway?
Back in October, CyberLeek promised to release the entire game if the coin hit that massive $30 million target. When the coin fell woefully short, the leaker said uploading more than 200 GB anonymously was too risky without the money to fund their “secret project”.
What’s changed is that there’s now a package people can inspect. If those 209 GB check out, which they seem to, then I’d be surprised if CyberLeek had somehow got hold of everything except the executable. Whether they’ll ever part with it is another question.
Which brings me to the choice of platform. The earlier footage was widely thought to show the game running on PC. If CyberLeek had a working PC build back then, what happened to that one? Why are we wow we’re being offered Xbox files with the executable held back? CyberLeek reckons somebody else will have the game emulated for PC inside a week, also begging the queston of why not release the PC build you seemingly already had? In the very same statement, they say they’ll try to get a PS5 build if the Xbox one doesn’t work and support holds.
Could somebody eventually get these files running on PC? I’m well outside my area of expertise on that one. The recompilation projects seen for older Xbox games typically start with the compiled game code or the source code , which is exactly why that missing executable matters. These files might give somebody a head start, but I’ve yet to see anyone demonstrate a PC version running from this download. Of course, it’s only been like five minutes, so it’s hardly a surprise nothing has popped up yet.
The bit I keep coming back to, though, is November. CyberLeek was already showing off 25 minutes of GTA 6 in early October, teasing that they already had a full build at that point. If “the full November 2026 build” means a newer version than the one in that footage, how did they get their hands on it this close to launch? Did they still have a source inside Rockstar feeding them newer builds? Or did they only get access to a complete copy recently, after spending October promising they could release one? Was the earlier footage actually from a much smaller version of the game?
There’s a simpler possibility, too. With GTA 6 now on sale, these could be files from the retail Xbox release. A build number we could put alongside the retail one would tell us a hell of a lot more about where those 209 GB came from.
The other piece of timing is also interesting: the game is out now. CyberLeek waited to return and actually release files until the game launched. That doesn’t inspire confidence in some of his earlier build claims.
His target now is realistically PC gamers since they are being forced to sit and watch their console brethren enjoy the game, with zero announced launch date for the PC build. Again, though, questions must be asked: if PC gamers are the ones most eager to actually get the game, why release an Xbox build? Was it always an Xbox build? Hmm.
There’s too much strangness. None of this makes real sense, to me.

articles.t: 'GTA 6' release live updates: Reviews, memes and more as gamers explore and react to Vice City after 13 long years
articles.chapeau: After a long wait, the sequel to 'GTA 5' is out and people are stoked.
articles.txt:
A gamer plays "Grand Theft Auto VI" at a café in New Delhi on Nov. 19. (Bhawika Chhabra/Reuters) Grand Theft Auto VI is here at last and gamers around the world can finally play after it launched at midnight globally. So far the game, which takes up a whopping 212GB on your PlayStation5 or Xbox , is receiving rave reviews . GTA 6 is streaming all over Twitch and the memes, clips and hot takes are pouring in.
Digital marketing firm Sensor Tower estimates that GTA 6 pre-orders have already topped $1.65 billion in sales. GTA 6 costs $79.99 for PS5 and Xbox , with an "ultimate" version priced at $99.99.
Players began pre-loading GTA 6 last week, even though they probably had to clear some space on their consoles. Millions of people are expected to take time off work and school to play GTA 6 . Xbox has a doctor's note from DJ Khaled (aka Dr. Xbox) that may be the excuse you need (but you'll probably want to clear it with your boss either way).
PlayStation's network suffered a brief outage Wednesday afternoon as the game became available and players made the required update to their consoles. But since Wednesday evening, it's been smooth sailing.
One major change to GTA 6 that makes it more immersive than previous titles in the franchise is that it actively rewards you for not charging through every mission like a violent psychopath. Players have discovered that they earn a criminal profile based on how they play the game, unlocking certain bonuses across five different profile tiers: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable.
If you avoid unnecessary kills, use stealth and favor incapacitating enemies, you'll earn a Professional or Hardened criminal profile and unlock bonuses for continuing to play that way. If you go guns blazing through missions, you'll be marked as Violent or Psycho and be granted bonuses for being a good shot with your guns. However, you'll lose the ability to surrender to the cops at the Psycho level.
If you aren't careful, though, you'll end up in the Irredeemable category by indiscriminately killing and harming civilians. This level is permanent, and the only way to go back is to load an earlier save file before you earned it. Brutal.

articles.t: GTA 6 avis : 99 sur Metacritic, problèmes et sortie PC
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 avis après le lancement : 99 sur Metacritic et OpenCritic, les reproches des joueurs, ce que l'on sait de la sortie PC et l'effet sur l'action Take-Two.
articles.txt:
Sélectionne les sujets qui t'intéressent vraiment. Tes choix alimentent directement notre planification éditoriale.
Chaque semaine. 60 secondes de lecture. Soigneusement sélectionnées par nos rédacteurs : pas de hype, pas de mails promotionnels, pas de spam.
Pas de spam Politique de confidentialité Jeudi 19 novembre 2026 : GTA 6 est sorti. Rockstar a lancé le jeu dans le monde entier sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S ; l'édition standard coûte 79,99 € et l'Édition Ultime 99,99 € sur le PlayStation Store . La presse lui donne 99 sur 100, et les rares reproches portent sur les 30 images par seconde, des plantages pendant la nuit de lancement et une version PC toujours sans date. Pour tous ceux qui attendent depuis 2013, les tests sont unanimes : l'attente en valait la peine, malgré quelques réserves techniques.
Le verdict de la critique est quasi unanime. Sur Metacritic , la version PS5 obtient un Metascore de 99, avec 151 critiques positives, aucune mitigée et aucune négative. OpenCritic affiche une moyenne de 99 sur 88 critiques. La plupart des tests ont été publiés le 18 novembre, la veille de la sortie.
Notes au 19 novembre 2026 à 21h, heure de Paris. Les deux moyennes peuvent encore bouger avec les prochains tests.
Les éloges se ressemblent d'un média à l'autre. Jeuxvideo.com parle d'une claque comme on en prend tous les dix ans. Dans son test pour IGN , Luke Reilly qualifie GTA 6 de jeu vidéo le plus impressionnant auquel il ait jamais joué. The Guardian y voit à la fois le monde le plus dépravé et la plus belle histoire d'amour du jeu vidéo.
Quels problèmes pour GTA 6 au lancement ? Les critiques visent la technique et la nuit de lancement bien plus que le jeu lui-même. Trois points reviennent le plus souvent :
L'avis des joueurs reste à venir : jeudi soir, Metacritic n'affichait pas encore de note des utilisateurs. Sur Reddit, l'ambiance est pour l'instant euphorique : dans le fil des tests de r/gaming , ouvert le 18 novembre et riche de plus de 6 000 commentaires, une réponse saluée par plus de 10 000 votes s'étonne simplement du 99.
D'après les tests, oui : sur Metacritic, aucun média n'a jugé GTA 6 mitigé ou négatif, et IGN, GameSpot et Eurogamer lui ont donné leur note maximale. Le seul vrai compromis reste la fluidité : qui tient au 60 images par seconde ne trouvera cette option sur aucune console.
Selon Digital Foundry, la PS5 Pro offre l'image la plus stable et la Xbox Series S la plus douce. Quelle console choisir et où l'acheter, c'est dans notre guide des consoles pour GTA 6 . Rockstar ajoute un bonus : le 19 novembre est le dernier jour où le Vintage Vice City Pack et un mois gratuit de GTA+ sont inclus à l'achat.
Officiellement, il n'y en a pas. L'annonce de lancement de Rockstar ne cite que la PlayStation 5 et la Xbox Series X|S, et le communiqué de résultats de Take-Two du 9 novembre liste les deux mêmes plateformes.
L'indice le plus concret vient de GamesBeat : sur la foi de quatre sources anonymes du secteur, Alexander Lee affirme que Rockstar prévoit la version PC pour le premier trimestre 2027 (article publié le 13 octobre, mis à jour le 18 novembre). Rockstar n'a pas répondu à GamesBeat ; cette fenêtre reste donc une information de presse, pas une annonce.
GTA 6 est-il déjà un succès ? Ce que dit Take-Two Auprès de la critique, sans aucun doute ; en ventes, il n'existe pas encore de chiffre officiel. Take-Two n'a publié aucune donnée de ventes pour GTA 6. Son PDG Strauss Zelnick a déclaré à CNBC le 10 novembre que les précommandes dépassaient largement les attentes, sans donner de chiffre.
Les objectifs du groupe sont publics. Lors de ses résultats du deuxième trimestre, le 9 novembre, Take-Two a confirmé viser 8,0 à 8,2 milliards de dollars de net bookings sur l'exercice 2027, clos le 31 mars 2027, et 3,35 à 3,50 milliards pour le trimestre d'octobre à décembre, le premier avec les ventes de GTA 6. Le communiqué de lancement rappelle l'ampleur de la série : près de 235 millions d'exemplaires pour GTA V, près de 480 millions pour l'ensemble des GTA.
L'action a davantage bougé avant le lancement que le jour même. TTWO a clôturé à 227,82 dollars le vendredi 13 novembre, a reculé de 10,5 % à 203,93 dollars jusqu'à mardi, a gagné 6,2 % à 216,61 dollars mercredi, jour de publication des tests, et s'échangeait à 212,25 dollars jeudi à 21h01, heure de Paris, en baisse de 2,0 % (cours du Nasdaq selon Yahoo Finance ).

GTA 6 : un hacker affirme avoir mis en ligne une build de développement, la communauté sceptique
articles.txt:
Un individu se présentant sous le pseudonyme de Cyberleek a récemment fait surface en affirmant avoir mis en ligne une build de développement de Grand Theft Auto VI . Cette annonce, qui a immédiatement enflammé les réseaux sociaux et les forums spécialisés, est accueillie avec un très haut degré de scepticisme par la communauté. En effet, le nom de Cyberleek est associé à de précédentes tentatives de fuites, souvent jugées peu crédibles, et aucune preuve tangible n’a pour l’instant été apportée pour étayer ces nouvelles déclarations.
Selon les informations relayées par Video Games Chronicle , Cyberleek n’avait plus fait parler de lui depuis la sortie officielle de GTA 6 . Son retour soudain avec une annonce aussi fracassante a de quoi surprendre, d’autant que le jeu est désormais disponible depuis plusieurs mois et que l’attention des joueurs s’est tournée vers d’autres sujets, comme les mises à jour en ligne ou les éventuels contenus additionnels. La prétendue build de développement serait donc antérieure à la version finale, ce qui soulève immédiatement des questions sur son intérêt réel et sur les motivations de son diffuseur.
Les experts en cybersécurité et les dataminers habitués à ce genre de fuites rappellent que les builds de développement sont des versions internes utilisées par les studios pour tester le jeu en cours de production. Elles contiennent souvent du contenu inachevé, des bugs, des outils de debug et parfois des éléments qui ne sont pas destinés au public. Si une telle build venait à être authentifiée, elle pourrait révéler des détails sur le processus de création du jeu, mais elle n’apporterait probablement rien de nouveau aux joueurs qui ont déjà exploré la version finale.
Le pseudonyme Cyberleek n’est pas inconnu des communautés de joueurs. Par le passé, ce même individu ou groupe a déjà prétendu détenir des informations exclusives sur des jeux très attendus, sans jamais fournir de preuves convaincantes. La plupart de ses annonces se sont soldées par des échecs retentissants, et sa crédibilité est aujourd’hui quasi nulle auprès des observateurs sérieux. Cette nouvelle sortie médiatique est donc perçue comme une énième tentative de se faire remarquer, surfant sur la notoriété de GTA 6 pour attirer l’attention.
Il est important de noter que Rockstar Games, le développeur du jeu, n’a fait aucun commentaire officiel sur cette affaire. La société est connue pour sa discrétion et sa politique stricte en matière de sécurité, et il est peu probable qu’elle réagisse à des allégations non fondées. En l’absence de déclaration officielle ou de preuve matérielle, il convient de traiter cette information avec la plus grande prudence.
Au-delà de la simple désinformation, ce type d’annonce peut avoir des conséquences néfastes pour les joueurs. Certains individus mal intentionnés profitent de l’engouement autour des jeux populaires pour diffuser des logiciels malveillants déguisés en builds ou en outils de piratage. Les joueurs trop crédules qui tenteraient de télécharger ces prétendues versions s’exposent à des risques de vol de données, d’infection de leur système ou d’escroquerie. Il est donc essentiel de ne jamais télécharger de fichiers provenant de sources non officielles et de se méfier des offres trop alléchantes.
Par ailleurs, la diffusion de builds de développement, si elle était avérée, constituerait une violation grave des droits d’auteur et des secrets commerciaux de Rockstar Games. Les précédentes fuites majeures dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo ont donné lieu à des poursuites judiciaires et à des condamnations sévères. Les auteurs de telles infractions encourent des peines de prison et des amendes considérables, ce qui n’a pas empêché certains de récidiver.
Sur les réseaux sociaux, les réactions à l’annonce de Cyberleek oscillent entre amusement et agacement. De nombreux joueurs rappellent les précédentes frasques de ce personnage et invitent à ne pas lui accorder de crédit. D’autres soulignent que même si une build de développement existait, elle n’aurait que peu d’intérêt à ce stade, le jeu étant déjà sorti et largement analysé. Certains évoquent la possibilité d’un canular destiné à tester la réactivité des médias et des communautés.
En attendant d’éventuelles preuves concrètes, il est recommandé de considérer cette information comme une rumeur non fondée. Les joueurs désireux d’en savoir plus sur GTA 6 peuvent se tourner vers les sources officielles de Rockstar Games ou vers des médias reconnus

articles.t: Cyberleek claims to release development build of GTA 6 | VGC
articles.chapeau: Cyberleek is back for the first time since GTA 6’s release…
articles.txt:
Hacker group Cyberleek has returned for the first time since Grand Theft Auto 6’s launch and is claiming to have released a development build of the game on their site.
The site’s latest update shows a link titled: “ XBOX BUILD 1.0.2.1 (NOV 2026)”.
Screenshots being shared on social media appear to show that the files are from a development build of GTA 6’s Xbox release. The executable file is missing, preventing people with access from playing the build themselves.
In a statement, Cyberleek threatened to release the executable at a later date.
“It is done,” the statement reads. “CL [Cyberleek] holds the full November 2026 build of Grand Theft Auto VI, and it is going out by torrent. Now. Every file except one — the main executable — held on a countdown.
“It is an Xbox build this time, not a PC build. CL does not care. This community will have it emulated inside a week, running far past 30fps. CL told you not to preorder for a reason. This is one of the reasons.
“If the Xbox build cannot be made to work and support holds, CL will work to get a PS5 build — a fallback, most likely never required. Either way: the Xbox build is going out. No double dipping for Take-Two / Rockstar .”
Cyberleek goes on to say that the release of the executable file is on a timer. However, they also say they will release it earlier if their crypto token reaches a certain market value.
This comes as part of Cyberleek’s ongoing campaign against Rockstar , which they claim is in aid of consumer rights. They say they take particular issue with GTA 6 being a digital-only release.
The group has been posting authentic gameplay clips from Grand Theft Auto 6 for months, even ahead of Rockstar’s own official Netflix reveal .
However, Cyberleek has also enriched themselves greatly throughout this process. They have always encouraged crypto donations, and even made them mandatory if fans wanted to participate in polls to decide what was leaked next.
Take-Two previously indicated that its efforts to track down the leaker were “rapidly evolving”. The Rockstar parent company has filed multiple subpoenas to Discord, demanding information on specific servers and users.

How to Find the Jet-Ski-Driving Dog in GTA 6 (And Why You’ll Want To)
articles.chapeau: Meet Cool Dog, the jet-ski-driving canine who's winning over GTA 6 players with an unexpected rescue mission and a secret reward.
articles.txt:
X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Share using Native tools Share Copied to clipboard Add Us On Google Of the many attention-grabbing, exciting side quests and NPCs players can stumble upon in GTA 6, one of the most notable doesn’t have anything to do with stealing cars, pulling off a heist, or locking down a safe house . Instead, a lot of online hype is focused around a dog on a jet ski. And it’s important to note the dog isn’t just sitting on the jet ski – he’s driving it.
For anyone who hasn’t been fortunate enough to catch a glimpse of Cool Dog yet, he’s definitely a sight to behold. Perched on the back of a jet ski, his paws balanced on the handlebars, he has a pair of goggles on to protect his eyes from the glare off the water. He’s also sporting a lifejacket, because safety is important.
Not only is he ideally geared up for some fun out on the water, Cool Dog is actually there – at least in part – to help players who might have wandered a little too far from the shores of Leonida. Traveling out into the middle of the ocean on a boat and then going for a swim will summon Cool Dog after a few minutes, his appearance heralded by a chorus of barking. It’s important for the player to make sure they are far away from land or any type of boat, so Cool Dog can do his cool job, and perform a rescue.
Cool Dog will wait for the player to get on the jet ski, nudging them along with more barking and hopeful whimpers. Once Jason or Lucia climbs aboard the jet ski – behind Cool Dog, of course – he manages to make the situation even better. After being saved at sea by a dog driving a jet-ski, the player is then taken to an island full of dogs, where they can play with the canine population.
There’s a Dog Driving a Jet Ski in ‘GTA 6,’ and Somehow That’s Not Even the Best Part But that’s not all. After Jason and Lucia have amused the dogs by playing fetch and petting them, Cool Dog will then lead them to actual buried treasure. While it’s not the pile of gold coins in a wooden chest the image might conjure up, it’s still just as good, if not better – $1,200 in cash. Considering players can accomplish this fun little side quest at the beginning of the game, it’s a good way to pad the GTA 6 bank account right from the jump.
According to the GTA 6 News and Updates account on X, Cool Dog is actually inspired by a real-life pup from Florida! Like Cool Dog, the dog has its own pair of goggles and a life jacket on, and can be seen perched on the back of a jet ski as they are carefully towed through the water.

GTA 6 : Standard ou Ultime, quelle édition choisir ?
articles.chapeau: 79,99 € pour le jeu, 99,99 € pour le jeu avec des suppléments. Les tarifs de GTA 6 sont les mêmes sur le PlayStation Store français et sur la boutique Xbox française . Ce sont les prix des...
articles.txt:
GTA 6 coûte 79,99 € en Standard et 99,99 € en Ultime sur les boutiques françaises de PlayStation et Xbox. Reste à voir ce que les vingt euros de plus apportent, et ce que contient vraiment la boîte PS5. 79,99 € pour le jeu, 99,99 € pour le jeu avec des suppléments. Les tarifs de GTA 6 sont les mêmes sur le PlayStation Store français et sur la boutique Xbox française . Ce sont les prix des versions numériques, qui ne disent évidemment rien des remises proposées chez les revendeurs.
Les deux éditions donnent accès à l’aventure de Jason et Lucia. Le choix se fait donc sur les ajouts de l’Ultime, pas sur la possibilité de terminer l’histoire avec la Standard.
L’Ultime ajoute des véhicules, des armes et des possibilités de personnalisation, mais aussi des activités et des lieux particuliers. Ce serait donc aller un peu vite que de la réduire à quelques vêtements. Parmi les exemples présentés figurent la Grotti Cheetah de 1995 et les revolvers Morgan de Hawk & Little. Les bonus se débloquent au fil de l’histoire : acheter cette édition ne signifie pas retrouver immédiatement tout son contenu dans le garage.
Pour choisir, autant regarder les ajouts qui vous intéressent réellement. Si vous voulez surtout suivre l’histoire et découvrir le Leonida, la Standard contient déjà le jeu. Si les véhicules et activités supplémentaires vous attirent, la présentation de l’Ultime permet de vérifier ce que vous achetez. Notre revue de presse des tests de GTA 6 porte, elle, sur l’accueil du jeu, pas sur la valeur de ces seuls bonus.
Oui. Sur Xbox, la mise à niveau est vendue 20 € et nécessite de posséder le jeu de base. Sur PS5, Sony indique que le passage à l’Ultime se fait sur le PlayStation Store, y compris si l’on a acheté la Standard en boîte. Il faut bien choisir le supplément correspondant à sa plateforme.
Voilà un détail à connaître avant de passer en caisse. D’après l’ assistance PlayStation , l’édition Standard physique PS5 contient un code de téléchargement, sans disque. Acheter la boîte ne dispense donc pas de télécharger le jeu. Notre guide d’installation de GTA 6 sur PS5 et Xbox reprend les étapes et les vérifications utiles avant de lancer le transfert.
Ces prix concernent les consoles. Pour un achat sur ordinateur, mieux vaut commencer par la situation de la version PC de GTA 6 . Les plateformes et les autres informations pratiques sont rassemblées dans notre dossier principal sur GTA 6 . Sur Xbox One, il faut aussi compter avec les conditions d’accès au cloud .

articles.t: Key Largo’s Caribbean Club draws GTA 6 fans
articles.chapeau: KEY LARGO — The Caribbean Club, Key Largo’s legendary waterfront bar, has been drawing waves of Grand Theft Auto fans leading up to the launch of GTA VI video game
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 returns gamers to Vice City and a Florida Keys analogue, with Key Largo’s Caribbean Club doubling on-screen as the Rusty Anchor.
KEY LARGO — The Caribbean Club, Key Largo’s legendary waterfront bar, has been drawing waves of Grand Theft Auto fans leading up to the launch of GTA VI video game Thursday, Nov. 19, with the venue doubling in-game as the Rusty Anchor in the “Leonida Keys.”
Rockstar Games’ latest entry returns players to Vice City — a fictionalized Miami — and expands into Leonida, a Florida stand-in whose southern archipelago mirrors the Florida Keys.
2013’s “Grand Theft Auto V” sold more than 230 million units worldwide and hit $1 billion in sales in three days, underscoring expectations for the new release.
GTA VI features ex-con Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval, a former soldier tied to drug runners who begins his story in the Leonida Keys before a botched job pulls both into a broader conspiracy.
In-game, the Leonida Keys connect to the mainland by long ocean bridges along a Keys Causeway, with islands such as Key Lento — home to the Rusty Anchor — East Key, Catalan Key and Goose Key.
Players can island-hop by boat, small plane or coastal highways amid wildlife including sea turtles, iguanas and reef fish.
Several Florida Keys landmarks are recognizable, including the Seven Mile Bridge and Key West’s Mallory Square.

articles.t: Your GTA 6 car is your Red Dead 2 horse, and it
articles.chapeau: My whip is my home.
articles.txt:
(Image credit: Rockstar) {alert('Link copied')}).catch(err => {console.error('Failed to copy: ', err)})" data-platform="copy_link" data-action="" class="font-ui-heading py-2 text-sm text-neutral-700 hover:bg-neutral-100 transition-colors no-underline block cursor-pointer border-0 bg-transparent w-full text-left normal-case" aria-label="Copy link" role="menuitem" data-analytics-id="article-social" analytics-label="utility-bar-social-share-copy-link" analytics-name="utility-bar-secondary" data-mrf-recirculation="article-social"> Copy link Facebook X Reddit Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Every time the very concept of a GTA 6 has come up in the past eight years, I've had just one wistful opinion to contribute: "I hope they make it more like Red Dead Redemption 2."
I'm not a huge GTA guy, but I am a Red Dead head. The sequel is Rockstar's best work (maybe second best now?) because of all the ways it prioritizes roleplay and choice-making by simulating the little things: Mixing tonics, crafting bullets individually, grooming Arthur's mustache. God, I love that stuff.
There was no way Rockstar would repeat all of these life sim-y touches for the louder and faster GTA 6, but I am surprised and elated that my favorite Red Dead 2 feature of them all made the cut: Your car is your horse.
That is to say, Jason and Lucia's personal vehicles are their mobile bases—an essential extension of them. You can't pet or name it, sadly, but it's important to keep track of and take care of your whip, because it's where you keep all your guns and outfits. It's all literally in the trunk: If you want to fetch your shotgun, you have to walk to the back of the car, open it up, and fish it out of a box.
Gone are the days of keeping seven assault rifles, ten SMGs, and four rocket launchers in your back pocket—you can only equip two "long" guns on your back, and large melee weapons like bats have to be stowed away, too. Aside from how cool it is to fish a shotgun out of my trunk like a disgruntled Jason Statham character, the limitation is forcing me to think twice about how to approach missions.
And unlike in Red Dead's lawless towns, the NPCs of Leonida seem to react negatively to the guy walking around with assault rifles on his back. The game tells you early on that police pay closer attention to you when openly carrying firearms—another reason to stow them away when you don't need 'em.
The car trunk is also where extra outfits can be stored. You can bring along five by default (more than Red Dead's saddles allowed), and even this isn't just for vanity. GTA 6's wanted system goes further than police chases: if you lose the cops, your wanted level will linger and cops identify you based on your description, clothes, and your car. The easiest way to go incognito after raising cain is to pull over, pop the trunk, and change outfits.
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.
It's all very smart and cool and I love it. Though I can also understand why others wouldn't—it's a significant break from what GTA has been up to this point. The two gun limit means murderous rampages might end earlier than they used to, and I can foresee getting annoyed the first time I bring a sniper rifle to a shotgun fight and have no way to correct that. But I think this reflects how Rockstar designed GTA 6 to be just as much a life sim as a crime fantasy.
GTA 6 wants me to constantly make choices and consider what a real human would do. Like in one mission last night, I was left alone without my personal vehicle for the first time. Instead of Rockstar suggesting I grand theft an auto, a tutorial popped for calling a cab. So yea, I took a yellow cab back to my car a few miles away, and it was a chill ride, except for the cabbie who rudely shot down my attempts to make small talk. He's lucky my guns were in my car.

articles.t: ‘GTA 6’ Sales Have Already Surpassed Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’
articles.chapeau: The Rockstar Games epic has generated $1.84 billion in sales — and it just launched today.
articles.txt:
For those wondering why Rockstar Games hasn’t licensed Grand Theft Auto for a movie or TV show, this is probably why.
Grand Theft Auto VI has already generated an incredible $1.84 billion in sales, according to market intelligence firm Sensor Tower .
That’s more than Christopher Nolan ‘s blockbuster The Odyssey made during its entire global run ($1.80 billion).
What’s more amazing, is GTA 6 ‘s eye-popping sales figure may already be outdated. While Sensor Tower updated its tracker Thursday, the underlying charts appear to only show pre-sales through Tuesday — meaning that $1.84 billion estimate doesn’t yet account for yesterday (when all those glowing reviews were published) or today (when the game was actually released). Related Stories Business 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Has a Small 'Deadpool' Connection Business 'GTA VI' Industry Domination Will Not End Anytime Soon
Therefore, current GTA 6 sales is very likely over $2 billion (in case you’re curious, the revenue split is 75 percent from PS5 sales and 25 percent for Xbox).
And GTA games tend to have very, very long tails. GTA 5 was released 13 years ago and has generated an estimated $5.4 billion in lifetime revenue (plus an additional $5.4 billion in revenue during that period from GTA Online), according to The Wall Street Journal . Even over the last four years, GTA 5 has averaged $400 million in sales … for, again, a game released in 2013. The top-grossing movie in 2013 was Disney’s Frozen , which made $1.28 billion … now imagine if last year Frozen was still averaging $400 million a year in ticket sales.
Going back to that question up top, Rockstar Games is likely disinclined to risk its brand value or reputation through a movie or TV project given the revenue for the company would probably end up being a pretty small fraction of what they already make from the game itself.
As Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar’s parent company Take-Two Interactive, told The David Rubenstein Show earlier this month: “We’re very careful about line extensions because this is a creative company and our goal is to make the best entertainment on earth, entertainment we’re always proud of. We would make a movie or television show based on our intellectual property if our creative teams were passionate about it, if they thought they would somehow engage and delight our consumers. It’s a high bar to do that. And of course, there’s always a risk of failure. So we don’t rule it out, but we’re very, very selective.”

articles.t: Let’s Talk About Sex In GTA 6, Baby - Kotaku
articles.chapeau: Let's talk about all the good things and the bad things that may be
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6 is a love story , should you choose to play it that way. For a lot of romantic pairings, sex is a big part of that , and sex has historically been a big part of Grand Theft Auto . So, naturally, the crime-doing couple Jason and Lucia can be all up in each other’s business throughout the game. How does it all work? Let’s break it down.
Once you’re able to play as both Jason and Lucia, you’ll have a relationship meter that determines how close they are. This can go up and down based on whether or not you buy each other gifts, do errands, or just chat with your partner and spend time together. As the relationship solidifies, you can give your partner hugs and kisses, which are activated by interacting with your partner with the left trigger and hitting whatever context-sensitive button prompts are on screen.
Then, as things escalate, you’ll find there are multiple sex scenes that you can see when there’s a button prompt signaled by two hearts on the interact menu. Yeah, it’s a bit mechanical and video gamey, but once you get past the absurdity of the “press button to do the sex,” you’ll see some brief sex scenes that aren’t quite X-rated explicit, but might show the occasional butt or boobs before fading to black. The scene might vary depending on where you are in the game, and can take place in bedrooms or showers.
That’s not to say that Jason and Lucia are just your sex dolls to approach and fuck at any given point. Characters might not be feeling it and can deny your advances, and you can do the same. Our reviewer Zack Zwiezen told me about how one time when playing as Jason, Lucia knocked on the door and asked to join him, and he was given a choice whether or not to invite her in.
So yeah, if you came here looking for a guide on how to see Jason and Lucia bump uglies, just know that the sex scenes are peppered throughout the game rather than scripted to only come up at a few climactic moments. Just be good to each other and it’ll happen.

articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games a caché la Mitsubishi Eclipse de Paul Walker dans Fast and Furious à l'intérieur d'un garage de Vice City sur GTA 6.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games a caché la Mitsubishi Eclipse de Paul Walker dans Fast and Furious à l’intérieur d’un garage de Vice City sur GTA 6.
Impossible de concevoir un jeu centré sur les braquages et les courses-poursuites sans rendre hommage au cinéma automobile. À peine Grand Theft Auto VI sorti, les joueurs ont débusqué un clin d’œil appuyé à la saga Fast and Furious et au regretté Paul Walker , disparu en 2013. Il est en effet possible de prendre le volant d’une réplique de la célèbre Mitsubishi Eclipse verte conduite par son personnage, Brian O’Connor, dans le tout premier volet de la franchise en 2001.
Contrairement à d’autres secrets qui demandent des heures d’exploration, ce bolide est accessible dès le début de l’aventure , sitôt les premières séquences d’introduction terminées. Il suffit d’entreprendre le trajet jusqu’à Vespucci Island , dans Vice City, et de repérer une villa abritant un garage fermé .
Une fois à l’intérieur de la propriété, il faut forcer une porte menant au garage pour découvrir la sportive garée à l’abri des regards. La méthode d’appropriation reste fidèle aux habitudes de la franchise : briser la vitre latérale et faire les fils à l’aide des joysticks de la manette. Beaucoup plus rapide que le véhicule de départ de Jason, cette monture permet d’arpenter l’asphalte floridien à vive allure dès les premières heures de jeu.
Les développeurs ont d’ailleurs glissé une seconde surprise dans ce même garage. En fracturant le coffre de la Mitsubishi Eclipse, le joueur se fait attaquer par un grand serpent caché à l’intérieur. Un jeu de mots visuel pensé pour les anglophones qui renvoie directement à la réplique culte du shérif Woody dans Toy Story (« There’s a snake in my boot « , le terme boot désignant aussi bien une botte que le coffre d’une voiture au Royaume-Uni).
Cette trouvaille automobile s’inscrit dans une chasse aux secrets déjà très prolifique à travers l’État de Leonida. En plus des références sérielles comme l’ appartement de Dexter Morgan à Washington Island – auquel nous avons consacré un article dédié -, les curieux ont mis au jour une foule de clins d’œil. Entre un chien à lunettes de soleil pilotant un jet-ski près de Gambit Bay , ou encore de véritables œufs de Pâques perchés au sommet d’une tour de télécommunication , Rockstar Games prouve une nouvelle fois son goût pour les détails dissimulés.
De quoi occuper les joueurs pendant des centaines d’heures en marge de la trame principale.

articles.t: Armes GTA 6 : Où trouver le sniper SMS-01 et de l'arsenal gratuit dès le début
articles.chapeau: Lorsque vous démarrerez votre partie dans Grand Theft Auto VI, Jason n’aura accès qu’à des fonds limités et ne pourra donc pas se [...]
articles.txt:
Lorsque vous démarrerez votre partie dans Grand Theft Auto VI , Jason n’aura accès qu’à des fonds limités et ne pourra donc pas se balader avec un arsenal complet sur lui, étant donné que les armes demandent une certaine somme. Heureusement, vous pouvez aussi en voler. Surtout dans une maison du sud-est de Key Lento, accessible dès le début du jeu, où vous attendent un fusil à pompe, des munitions et votre premier sniper : le Fusil de précision SMS-01 , l’une des armes uniques de GTA 6 .
Où trouver des armes et un sniper dès le début de GTA 6 ? Pas besoin d’aller très loin dans GTA 6 pour équiper Jason comme une machine de guerre. Et pas besoin d’aller à l’armurerie non plus. Ce qu’on vous propose ici, c’est un moyen simple, rapide, et presque sans danger pour avoir accès à tout un tas d’armes de poing et d’épaule très facilement à quelques mètres de la maison de notre héros.
Pour cela, rendez-vous au sud-est de la région de Key Lento, à l’endroit indiqué sur la map ci-dessus (là où vous voyez l’icône Munitions). Vous trouverez ici une simple maison qui n’a rien de particulier au premier abord.
En montant jusque devant la porte d’entrée, vous verrez un panneau « Attention au chien dangereux », mais pas de panique, ce n’est qu’un leurre. Enfoncez la porte pour vous retrouver nez-à-nez devant un vieil homme, qui est une caricature parfaite de l’Américain adorateur d’armes à feu. Il va vous tirer dessus, mais deux coups de poing suffiront à l’endormir.
Une fois cela effectué, dépêchez-vous de faire le tour des lieux avant que la police n’arrive. Vous trouverez un coffre-fort avec un peu d’argent, mais surtout beaucoup d’armes et de munitions, que ce soit un fusil à pompe ou d’autres joyeusetés. Mieux encore, le Fusil de précision SMS-01 vous attend sagement . Il s’agit là de l’une des armes uniques du jeu, alors prenez-en bien soin.
Avec le Fusil de précision SMS-01 et le stock d’armes de cette maison de Key Lento, Jason va démarrer GTA 6 bien équipé. Pour garder les armes lourdes sous la main, pensez au coffre de vos véhicules personnels, détaillé (on vous en parle dans nos 15 conseils pour bien débuter dans GTA 6 ), et retrouvez toutes les autres astuces dans notre guide complet de GTA 6 .

articles.txt:
Ils sont de retour, mais Rockstar a changé les règles du jeu. On a fait le tour du menu pour vous donner la liste complète.
Depuis les premiers épisodes, les codes de triche font partie de l’ADN de GTA , et chaque nouvel épisode relance la même question chez les joueurs : quelles combinaisons faut-il taper ? Ce n’est pas un hasard. GTA est le bac à sable par excellence, et tout le monde finit tôt ou tard par mettre l’histoire de côté pour faire le boxon. On fait apparaître un char en pleine avenue, on se rend invincible, on se lance dans une course-poursuite qui n’a aucun sens. Certains le font en plus de l’aventure, d’autres jouent uniquement pour ça. GTA 6 ne fait pas exception, par contre la façon d’y accéder a bien changé.
Tout se passe dans le menu Progression, onglet Codes de triche . On y trouve 61 codes répartis en cinq catégories : Joueur, Combat, Générer un véhicule, Environnement et Filtres d’écran . Par contre, ne vous précipitez pas dessus dès vos premières heures à Vice City. Les codes de triche ne deviennent disponibles qu’une fois l’histoire de Jason et Lucia terminée, et donc toute la trame principale bouclée. Avant ça, impossible d’en activer un seul.
Et même une fois le générique passé, ce n’est pas fini. Chaque code doit ensuite être débloqué individuellement en jeu . Tant que ce n’est pas fait, le jeu l’affiche comme « Indisponible » et ne donne pas la combinaison, seulement la condition à remplir. Ces conditions vont d’une simple formalité, comme dépenser 2 500 $ en alcool, à de vrais défis, comme terminer tous les défis du jeu pour obtenir un avion de chasse.
Les codes deviennent donc une récompense de fin de partie, ce qui est assez paradoxal pour des triches. On comprend l’idée, puisque Rockstar veut visiblement éviter que les joueurs gâchent leur première découverte de Leonida avec un char ou des munitions infinies. Mais on regrette un peu l’époque où il suffisait de connaître la bonne combinaison pour semer le chaos dès la première heure.
Une fois un code débloqué, l’activation se fait en trois étapes sur PS5. On sort le téléphone avec la flèche du haut, on maintient L1 et R1, puis on tape la séquence sur la croix directionnelle. Attention, activer un code empêche de débloquer des trophées et désactive la sauvegarde pendant toute la session . Si vous tenez à votre progression, mieux vaut redémarrer le jeu une fois le carnage terminé.
Voici la liste complète des codes. Les combinaisons ne s’affichent qu’une fois le code débloqué , donc on vous donne celles qu’on a obtenues pendant notre partie, et on complétera au fur et à mesure.
Avec cette liste, on pourrait être tenté de récupérer les combinaisons sur internet, au fur et à mesure qu’elles circulent, pour sauter l’étape des défis. Il y a pourtant de fortes chances que ça ne serve pas à grand-chose. Déjà, rien ne fonctionnera tant que l’histoire principale n’est pas terminée. Ensuite, le jeu lie chaque code à sa condition de déblocage, donc une combinaison tapée sur une partie où le défi n’a pas été rempli a peu de chances de marcher . On n’a pas pu le vérifier sur tous les codes, mais tout dans le menu va dans ce sens : tant qu’un code est marqué « Indisponible », le jeu ne le considère pas comme acquis.
Il faudra donc mouiller le maillot avant de semer le chaos. C’est un vrai changement par rapport aux anciens épisodes, où connaître la bonne séquence suffisait. Rockstar transforme ainsi la triche en récompense, et le résultat est plutôt malin puisque ça pousse à découvrir des activités qu’on aurait sans doute ignorées, comme la pêche, la méditation ou les stands de tir. Les plus pressés vont forcément râler. Mais une fois le char Rhino ou le Hauners P-996 LAZER débloqués, on se dit que le boxon n’en est que plus mérité.

articles.t: GTA 6’s Best-Kept Secret Is the Most Important Part of the Game
articles.chapeau: The prologue of GTA 6 starts with a shock
articles.txt:
Considering how much of Grand Theft Auto 6 leaked before its launch, you’d think that Rockstar’s latest wouldn’t have anything left to hide. I mean, we’ve really seen it all. But as players immediately discovered when starting their save file, Rockstar (kind of) managed to keep one secret — and it was a huge one.
[Ed. note: This article contains spoilers for the prologue of GTA 6. ]
GTA 6 kicks off with a short prologue chapter that sets a few things in motion . First, we get to see the moment Jason and Lucia met , as they both got crossed trying to jack the same car. A rom-com montage ensues, but things take a turn fast. We fast-forward to Lucia sitting in a restaurant as she prepares to pull off a robbery across the street. After nervously stalling , she works up the courage to stick the place up. Unfortunately, it doesn’t go well. The cops quickly intervene and arrest her.
The twist comes as she’s being put into the back of a cop car. A panicked Lucia begs the cops to take her back to the restaurant where she was holed up before the robbery, because she left something there. The cops discover something that the camera was carefully hiding earlier in the sequence: Lucia’s infant son, Tommy, who she left unattended.
As we soon learn, Tommy is Jason and Lucia’s son. Tommy now lives with a separate guardian after getting taken from Lucia’s custody; Jason and Lucia only get to see him through occasional photos that get texted to them. It turns out that Jason and Lucia’s whole motivation for making cash in GTA 6 is to fund a family savings account in hopes that they can reunite with their son and give him a normal life.
Image: Rockstar Games via Polygon It’s a shocking revelation that Rockstar desperately wanted to keep hidden as long as possible. No pre-release trailers for the game so much as teased that there was a kid in the picture. When I spoke to Rockstar North co-head Rob Nelson just ahead of the game’s launch, he seemed relieved that the detail had mostly gone unspoiled, despite a cavalcade of leaks. (It actually did leak about a year ago, but it faded into a forgotten rumor in a sea of them by the time GTA 6 actually launched.) For Nelson, that initial shock is an important part of an experience that’s designed to challenge what you think you know about its antiheroes at every turn.
With Tommy comes a mess of complicated character dynamics and anxieties that you’ll see throughout GTA 6 ’s story. While Lucia seems like an impulsive loudmouth who doesn’t have a care in the world, it becomes increasingly clear that she’s harboring serious insecurity after having Tommy taken from her. She quietly worries that she doesn’t deserve to be a parent after leaving her kid to go pull off a stick-up. While Jason wasn’t part of that, he holds the same fear that someone like him isn’t responsible enough to be a father. Those feelings bleed out whenever the two receive a text with a photo of Tommy and are reminded of the kid who is growing up somewhere without them.
Tommy also adds some welcome tension into Jason and Lucia’s love story, considering that the romance can be largely free of friction otherwise (depending on how you engage with the romance system). At one point, the two broke into a spontaneous conversation about their family. Jason noted that Lucia’s mother doesn’t seem to like him very much, which prompted Lucia to reveal that she lied to her mom and told her that Jason didn’t want to be involved in Tommy’s life. Though that isn’t exactly true given that Jason didn’t know his son existed, Lucia then recalled a conversation where Jason told her he didn’t want to have kids. That exchange gives us context that explains why Lucia didn’t tell Jason about Tommy upfront. For Nelson, those little details help build a nuanced story of two reluctant parents trying to figure out how to adapt to an unexpected responsibility.

So, as a responsible guide writer, I loaded up the game and proceeded to spend my initial hours beelining around Leonida's hotspots. There are a few different strip clubs in Leonida, each with their own price range and different activities to try (that sounds sordid, but I'm also talking about, like, pool tables).
There are three strip clubs in the game I've found, plus a load of other night spots, like the Rusty Anchor close to where Jason starts, that have drinking and other activities, too.
This fancy strip club in downtown Vice City is the classiest option you have available, but also the priciest. It's quite easy to get here, even from Leonida Keys where Jason starts—just drive along route 1 towards Hamlet, merge onto route 97, and head north into Downtown. The clubs are just to the right of the giant crossroads route interchange in west Vice City. NINE1NINE itself is next door to The Vault club. This is the best option if you have a lot of money to burn, but also it feels a bit too fancy.
If you want a private dance, same as with previous GTA games, you just need to greet the dancer in question and then use the interaction icon to pay for it. Since this club is fancier, you can also get a private dance by interacting with the person by the entrance to the private rooms.
I appreciated NINE1NINE's lively club atmosphere, but I also ran out of cash very fast. Maybe one to try later in the game when you're a lot richer.
This strip club in Vice City's Crosstown is directly north from NINE1NINE, but there's a catch: this place only unlocks via the main story . I assume it's Chapter 3, considering that's when you meet its owner, but either way, it'll be a while before you can visit this establishment.
I assume in terms of price range, it's fancier than Delights (the cheapest option), but less fancy than NINE1NINE. This club gets one star because it wouldn't let me in, though maybe I'll change this review once I actually get inside.

Delights in Port Gellhorn is your cheapest option and it's a bit more rough and ready relative to NINE1NINE. articles.t: GTA 6 could require Ryzen 7 9800X3D as leaker thinks "most PCs won't hit 60 FPS"
articles.chapeau: There is a debate raging online regarding the performance of GTA 6. Some people think that, considering the console performance of GTA 6, it is unlikely that most PC gamers will be able to run the game at 60 FPS.
articles.txt:
The performance of Grand Theft Auto 6 on consoles has made a lot of people think about the eventual performance potential of the PC port and what specs the game will need to run at 60 FPS. Kepler_L2, known for his reliable hardware leaks, opines on X that most PC gamers won't be able to play GTA 6 at 60 FPS. The leaker has based this on the performance of GTA 6 on the Sony PS5 and Xbox Series consoles. The Xbox Series S is especially bad in this regard .
GTA 6 is super CPU-heavy. Current-gen gaming consoles, including the PS5 Pro, feature weak CPUs that will soon be four generations old soon. So, GTA 6 might never be able to run at 60 FPS on consoles , even with post-launch patches.
PC component reviewer Hardware Unboxed explains that Kepler’s statement “is correct”, and even capable-but-old CPUs like the Ryzen 7 5800X3D might fail to run GTA 6 at 60 FPS. HU claims that the Ryzen 7 5800X3D is not “twice as fast as the PS5 CPU”. So, if it is indeed the case that the PS5 CPU is responsible for 30 FPS , it is likely that “all AM4 CPUs will fail to run the game at 60 FPS”.
In other words, HU thinks that people who are still running an AM4 CPU, including the Ryzen 7 5800X3D, will need to upgrade to get GTA 6 running at 60 FPS or more. Many gamers have voiced strong opposition to this opinion, and some arguments make sense.
Unlike the console versions, the GTA 6 PC port will undoubtedly have lots of settings to tweak performance, including settings that could potentially lower the CPU burden. Rockstar could also optimize GTA 6 further, which will make running the game on CPUs like the Ryzen 7 5800X3D easier.
That said, GTA 6 will still demand lots of CPU horsepower on PCs, and image upscaling techniques like FSR/DLSS are unlikely to help, as FSR/DLSS mainly reduce the GPU workload. So, if you are running an older CPU and want to make sure that you can run GTA 6 at a smooth 60 FPS when it arrives, upgrade your CPU to a modern processor. CPUs like the Ryzen 7 9800X3D and the Core i9-14900K are going to be your best options. You might even be able to get away with a Ryzen 7 7800X3D or equivalent.

articles.txt:
From the sun-soaked synth-pop of Vice City to surfing a sea of radio stations, music has always been an essential part of Rockstar Games' gritty, open-world franchise. And with Grand Theft Auto VI taking players back to Vice City, the sprawling soundtrack is shaping up to be just as ambitious as the game itself.
Rockstar has already revealed a 34-track album featuring artists like Travis Scott, Cardi B, and PinkPantheress, along with an original score composed by the French electronic duo Justice. Meanwhile, the game's fictional radio stations are bringing some familiar voices to the airwaves, including Robyn, Bad Bunny, and Lana Del Rey.
And that's just what we know so far. Ahead of GTA 6 's Nov. 19 release , we're keeping track of every confirmed song, artist, radio station, and celebrity DJ coming to Leonida. Consider this your unofficial guide to the sounds of Vice City.
Rockstar has announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , a 34-track collection of original music arriving Nov. 19, the same day as the game.
The album features an eclectic mix of artists and genres , from hip-hop heavyweights Travis Scott and Cardi B to country star Morgan Wallen and Puerto Rican singer Rauw Alejandro. There's even a collaboration between CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.., and French producer Etienne de Crécy. And somehow, someway, Morgan Wallen's single is the most-streamed track from the soundtrack on Spotify, with more than 25 million streams. Yung Lean, fight back!

The French electronic duo Justice, consisting of Gaspard Augé and Xavier de Rosnay, is responsible for the original score of Grand Theft Auto VI .
Rockstar confirmed the news on Oct. 15 alongside the game's launch trailer , which features the debut of Justice's new single, "Flower in a Hurricane," featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard.
It's a fitting collaboration for a game returning to Vice City, a fictional playground known for its vibrant nightlife and electronic music. Justice's signature blend of distorted synths, disco, and dance music feels particularly suited to Rockstar's radiant criminal underworld.
The duo previously collaborated with Tame Impala on "Neverender" from their 2024 album Hyperdrama . The song won Best Dance/Electronic Recording at the 2025 Grammys.
Rockstar has also confirmed that an official score album is on the way, although additional details, including its release date and tracklist, have yet to be announced.
The fictional radio stations are one of Grand Theft Auto 's most beloved features, and GTA 6 is bringing some major star power to the airwaves.
On Oct. 8, Rockstar unveiled six radio stations , each with its own musical identity and celebrity hosts. Among the biggest names are Bad Bunny, Robyn, Lana Del Rey, Burna Boy, and members of Slayer.

articles.chapeau: Rockstar's developers have made use of ray-traced reflections and shadows, as well as global illumination, which are too resource intensive for a 60 FPS game.
articles.txt:
Asanka Ratnayake/Getty Images Add BGR on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover If you're part of the "Grand Theft Auto 6" mob that's been waiting so eagerly for the groundbreaking game to launch, you may have already heard that dreams of playing the game in a silky-smooth 60 FPS mode have been dashed. This news has caused a great deal of frustration among gamers globally, but the truth is that there's so much detail in "GTA 6" that none of the current flagship consoles can handle a 60 FPS experience. The technology just doesn't exist to support it yet.
Rockstar revealed this disappointing bit of news earlier this month, but if you consider it from the game-maker's perspective, it makes sense. Rockstar's developers have made use of ray-traced reflections and shadows, as well as global illumination. Both concepts help create ultrarealistic lighting in games and simulate how real-world rays of light travel through a scene. Global illumination is a lighting technique that simulates how light interacts with objects, and ray tracing realistically simulates reflections and soft shadows. Right now, ray-traced shadows are only available to PlayStation 5 Pro gamers on "GTA 6."
When used together, these techniques are resource-heavy, so trying to add more frames per second to an already demanding simulation would only result in a degraded experience. Rockstar would have had to ensure smooth gameplay on different consoles, and because not even the best-in-class PS5 Pro can handle it, it was always going to crank the frame rates down to keep the experience immersive regardless of individual settings. You can turn off motion blur in "GTA 6" in settings to bring out the game's best level of detail, though.
iama_sing/Shutterstock The biggest limitation that causes "GTA 6" to hit a wall at 60 FPS on consoles is the CPU bottleneck. Sony is reportedly working on the PlayStation 6, and there have been leaks that suggest that the necessary CPU performance to run "GTA 6" at 60 FPS is built into the package. According to a leak published by Moore's Law is Dead on YouTube , Sony intends to upgrade the current Zen 2 CPU cores with a four-generation leap, reportedly going for Zen 6.
If this rumor turns out to be true, it could have cores dedicated to OS operations while reserving higher-performing cores for gaming. This will likely enable Rockstar to add a performance mode to "GTA 6" that would make 60 FPS gameplay available. The PS6 could land in about a year, reportedly lined up for a late 2027 or early 2028 launch.
Regardless of what leaks are suggesting, it will be in Sony's best interest to build a console that supports the most demanding games out there, and "GTA 6" has already set a pretty solid target that Sony can aim for. In the meantime, "GTA 6" is still worth playing on the Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 .

articles.t: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
articles.chapeau: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.
articles.txt:
Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion Ryan Gladwin Wed, November 18, 2026 at 6:32 PM GMT+1 3 min read One lucky meme coin trader made bank as Grand Theft Auto 6 launched worldwide, turning $300 into over $200,000 after early footage of the game sent degens flocking from one unofficial token to another.
The trader bought $307 worth of the DCTY token shortly after it launched in October and has sold their bag for $202,278, according to DEX Screener, a profit of almost 66,000%.
Early indications had pointed to GTA 6 featuring an in-game meme coin—with, it's worth stressing, no actual blockchain element—called "DacityCoin," which appeared in the official launch trailer on a plane with a wing walker setting off a smoke bomb on top of it.
It was later linked to leaked gameplay of an mission which appeared to show game protagonist Lucia parachuting as a stunt to attract investment to DacityCoin .
Amid this hype, per DEX Screener, a real-world and unofficial DacityCoin launched using the Solana launchpad Pump.fun . It first peaked at a $4.95 million market capitalization, following the launch trailer's release, before tanking 93% to $343,620 as hype faded.
With GTA 6 set to launch within a matter of hours of publication, the token drew renewed attention, propelling it to a new all-time high of $10.8 million Wednesday. Unfortunately for investors, GTA 6's staggered global release means that some gamers are already playing it—and footage started to spread which suggested the Solana token's ticker was wrong.
The result was a rollercoaster of volatility, with the DacityCoin token now sitting at a market cap of around $800,000.
Gameplay footage from Brazilian streamer Combo Infinito suggests that the in-game token is called DacityCoin, with the ticker DCTY.
That propelled another Solana token with a seemingly accurate name and ticker sprang into action. DCTY's previous all-time high market cap was just $54,000 before the ticker was revealed, and it set a new high of over $12 million after footage of the game appeared to confirm that its ticker matched the in-game token. It is now trading at a market cap of around $10 million.
The game itself appears to be somewhat inconsistent in its naming of the in-game token. During the trailer, it appeared to be spelled "DacityCoin" as one word, however, the subtitles in the leak show it spelled as "Dacity coin," two words. Similarly, the company behind the in-game token is AudaCity, but leaks show three different spellings: Auda City, AudaCity, and Auda-City.
It is worth stressing: Rockstar has not explicitly confirmed that a meme coin will be featured in-game, and any real-world token has no official links to GTA 6 or its creators. Footage is still being released, and absolute confirmation of the in-game token's involvement is still being established.
Game Publishers Have Pushed to Cut Discs Since 2007, Infinity Ward Veteran Says
Those still holding the now-tanking DacityCoin are hoping things will turn around. Mike Lerro , the community takeover lead for DacityCoin, shrugged off any chance that the unofficial token's name and ticker are wrong.
"No, bro. DacityCoin and AudaCity are in the game. Yes or no?" When Decrypt suggested the ticker might be wrong, he replied, "It doesn't matter… Okay and ? The person who creates it will dump on you then it goes to zero. Who's gonna [do the community takeover]? No one."
"DACITYCOIN AND AUDACITY ARE IN THE GAME," Lerro wrote in the meme coin's Telegram. "NOTHING ELSE MATTERS."
"It's so crazy, it'll correct itself," Lerro said in an emergency Telegram group chat call. "I hope so," an investor replied.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance jumps to 280 fps on PC, with DLSS 5 transforming Lucia
articles.chapeau: Capture cards and Nvidia DLSS give a glimpse of what a GTA 6 PC port may look like. In a GameGPU test, the PS5 Pro version sees frame rates rise from 30 to 280 fps. DLSS 5 neural rendering enhances lighting and shadows, but Lucia may be unrecognizable compared with trailer footage.
articles.txt:
As the release date arrived, Rockstar cast doubt on future performance upgrades for the flagship PlayStation console. With frame rates stuck at 30 fps , the GTA 6 PS5 Pro version prioritizes visual fidelity. A PC port lurks as a way to experience smoother graphics. Using capture software and NeuralScreen, new videos show what DLSS 5 and high-end hardware can do.
GameGPU recorded multiple clips via an AVerMedia Live Gamer Ultra 2.1 external capture card connected to the PS5 Pro. PC specs include an AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D CPU and an Nvidia RTX 5090 graphics card . At maximum settings, the console’s video output was set to 4K.
In a scene where Lucia is still in prison, DLSS 4.5 frame generation produces frame rates between 262 and 286 fps. Nevertheless, players may find the effects of DLSS 5 controversial.
Nvidia’s neural rendering adds detail to the GTA 6 PS5 Pro feed throughout the jail cell. With light entering a window, reflections and shadows look more natural. Lucia’s individual strands of hair become visible, but her face has undergone the most obvious transformation.
Without DLSS 5 active on the PC, the character resembles what fans have seen in official trailers . When on, Lucia’s face is photorealistic with varied textures and a different skin tone. Many critics worry that neural rendering distorts the original vision of developers and artists.
The second video depicts Jason standing on a dock during a swampland mission. Thanks to frame generation, readings jump to as high as 278 fps, and GTA 6 performance avoids stutters . Nvidia’s AI technology again improves the lighting and shadows in the outdoor scene. Jason’s clothes display ripples, and his beard stubble is more noticeable.
Unfortunately, GameGPU’s setup is likely not a practical method to play the GTA 6 PS5 Pro release. Input lag threatens to delay controller inputs for steering cars and aiming guns . Alternatives like the SmoovPlay app rely on PS Remote Play , but they face the same issues. Rockstar has yet to comment on when a native PC port might debut.

articles.t: GTA 6 Album Leak: Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey, 34 Tracks
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 album leak names Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey and JENNIE among 34 tracks. See what Rockstar confirmed and what stays unconfirmed.
articles.txt:
Photo: Pexels contributor / Pexels Rockstar Games put Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album out on November 19, 2026, and the 34-song collection arrived with a leak already attached. A reported vinyl leak spilled a full lineup that includes Dua Lipa with “Go Easy,” Lana Del Rey with “Crazy For You,” and JENNIE with “Power Trip.” Rockstar has not published that list itself, and that gap between a convincing leak and an official confirmation is the real story of launch day.
Here is the short version. Rockstar officially confirmed the album, the 34-track format, the Vice City and Leonida setting, and the release date. It also named a handful of tracks ahead of time. Everything beyond that, from the three headline pop names to the exact running order, rests on the leak. Sources reportedly told Rolling Stone the leaked lineup is accurate, which makes it credible but still unconfirmed. Our earlier report on the 34-song tracklist covered the first wave of that leak, and this piece sorts what has since been settled from what has not.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the solid ground. Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album officially, and the announcement describes a collection of 34 original tracks. The announcement ties the music to the game’s world, naming Vice City and Leonida as the setting the songs speak to. The release date is November 19, 2026, the same day the game itself goes live.
That is the full list of what the official announcement locks down. It sounds thin, and it is. Rockstar has built its reputation on controlling information tightly, and the company released the album as a product before it released the names of most people on it. A reader hunting for a confirmed artist roster will find only a short set of names and nothing more.
The 34-track count matters because it frames the leak. When a leaked list arrives with the same number of songs the publisher announced, the list gains plausibility. A fake or partial list would likely miss the count. That does not prove each title is right, but it removes one easy reason to dismiss the leak outright.
The full lineup did not come from Rockstar. Reporting describes it as a vinyl leak, meaning the track list surfaced through a physical release rather than a press release or a trailer. Reports of that kind spread fast because a printed track list is concrete and easy to photograph, which is why the leak moved from fan forums to mainstream coverage within a short window.
Outlets including AOL.com and DLCompare.com ran the story, and the leaked artists drove the headlines. Dua Lipa, Lana Del Rey and JENNIE are three of the most streamed and most searched names in pop, so a list containing them spreads on its own. The timing also helped. The leak landed as the game went live in its first time zones, as New Zealand unlocked first , so the audience for anything GTA-related was at its largest.
Leaks like this follow a pattern. A physical product moves through manufacturing, shipping and retail, and every step adds a chance for an early look. Digital releases can be locked behind a single switch, but vinyl pressing plants, distributors and shops each hold copies days or weeks before street date. That supply chain, not a hack, is the likelier route here, though Rockstar has not explained how the list got out.
Three entries carry most of the attention. The leaked list credits Dua Lipa with “Go Easy,” Lana Del Rey with “Crazy For You,” and JENNIE with “Power Trip.” Each of those claims is unconfirmed by Rockstar Games. The label matters, because a headline that states them as fact overshoots what the evidence supports.
The three names reach very different audiences. Dua Lipa brings a dance-pop following with strong radio presence. Lana Del Rey brings a cinematic, nostalgic sound with a devoted following. JENNIE brings a global K-pop audience that rarely overlaps with traditional console players. If the leak is right, the album reads like a deliberate attempt to widen the crowd past gamers.
Pop fandoms are organized and loud. A single song placement can send a fan community searching for the game, the soundtrack and the launch details. That is a marketing channel Rockstar does not need to pay for in the usual way, since the artists’ own followers do the work. It also explains why search interest centers on the artist and song pairings rath

articles.t: GTA 6 reviews award 99 Metacritic score, topping GTA 4 to become Rockstar's top-rated
articles.chapeau: The GTA 6 Metacritic verdict is in, and reviews conclude it exceeds the loftiest expectations. On its release date, the title’s 99 Metascore beats Rockstar’s GTA 5, GTA 4, GTA 3, and Red Dead Redemption 2. It’s also tied with Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the aggregator’s top game of all time.
articles.txt:
As leaked, the GTA 6 review embargo expired when the title unlocked in New Zealand at midnight local time. Scores quickly populated Metacritic , averaging 99 and making it Rockstar ’s highest-rated game ever. Critics praise the massive Leonida map while dismissing concerns about a lackluster story .
Currently, the aggregator shows exclusively positive scores. Players who survived the long buildup to launch must wait 36 hours following the GTA 6 release date to submit user ratings. Even so, journalists are impressed and have awarded it Universal Acclaim status.
Despite fears that Rockstar would limit access to avoid leaks , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was anxious to read GTA 6 reviews. As it turns out, more than 140 outlets received Xbox or PS5 codes in recent weeks. After boasting about the studio’s past performance, Zelnick will welcome the latest Metacritic consensus.
ⓘ screenshot, Metacritic GTA 6 Metacritic score shown Jason and Lucia ’s crime epic edges out GTA 4 , which notched an average score of 98 in 1999. GTA 5 , GTA 3 , and Red Dead Redemption 2 are closely behind at 97. The game has also tied the 1998 N64 classic Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Metacritic’s highest-rated entry of all time .
Much larger than previous open-world maps , Leonida lives up to its promise, according to reviews. Each region has a unique feel, enhanced by an overhauled dynamic weather system . More buildings are explorable, addressing a popular fan request.
The fictional take on Florida can test the limits of Xbox and PS5 consoles. Although frame rates target 30 fps , release date performance impressions are reassuring. Digital Foundry measured sporadic dips below that mark, but the visuals generally remain smooth. Most importantly, controls are responsive even when rendering at below 60 fps.
When avoiding side activities, some GTA 6 reviews clock the time to complete Jason and Lucia’s story at around 60 hours. The overwhelming amount of content can stall the narrative’s pacing at times. Nevertheless, without revealing spoilers, the writing is compelling with unexpected twists.
Minor quibbles include a Vice City that's overly congested with cars and NPCs , which can slow missions. Regardless, Take-Two and Rockstar will be happy with the record-setting 99 GTA 6 Metacritic rating.

articles.t: Sortie de GTA 6 : démarrage en prison, braquage et fuite, musique dingue… On a vu les premières images du jeu de l’année

articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto 6, le jeu le plus attendu de l’année, voire de la décennie, est sorti à midi heure française en Nouvelle-Zélande. Donnant aux joueurs les plus impatients les premières images.
Depuis des semaines, le monde du jeu vidéo n’attend que ça : ça y est, Grand Theft Auto (GTA) 6 est enfin disponible, treize ans après le cinquième volet . Et les premiers chanceux à pouvoir y jouer sont les Néo-Zélandais, grâce au décalage horaire. Rockstar Games, l’éditeur du jeu, a en effet choisi de sortir son produit phare le jeudi 19 novembre à minuit heure locale de chaque pays. En France donc, les premières images et diffusions en direct sont accessibles depuis ce mercredi midi.
Une attente interminable et enfin les premières images, y compris venant de streamers français étant parvenus à mettre leur console à l’heure néo-zélandaise . Un premier chargement long, très long, laissant craindre à un bug. Puis des paramètres à configurer, reculant encore l’arrivée à Vice City, lieu où se déroule le jeu.
🚨BREAKING: GTA 6 Game intro officially released pic.twitter.com/UsX6ndby4n
D’entrée, le ton est donné : une première cinématique. Une voiture en train d’être volée et les deux protagonistes : Lucia et Jason. La police qui intervient, un premier coup de poing et des forces de l’ordre tabassées. Le tout avec une musique immersive, mais bloquée chez certains streamers pour des raisons de droits d’auteur. Bienvenue dans GTA 6. La scène suivante montre les deux protagonistes chez eux… en pleine embrouille.
Après de nombreux crédits, une nouvelle cinématique transporte le joueur dans la vie de Lucia, neuf mois avant les premières scènes. Puis un nouveau flash-back. Lucia est cette fois en prison, tenue orange typique des détenus américains sur le dos.
Officially GTA 6 GAMEPLAY ( Intro Prison Scene #GTA6 ) pic.twitter.com/4R7FMkitnI
C’est là que le jeu commence vraiment. Lucia est contrôlable dans un monde ouvert, typique des GTA aux graphiques qui semblent soignés malgré les 30 images par seconde. Fidèle aux attentes sur ce point.
L’ellipse narrative prend fin, retour dans un bar avec Lucia. Quelques secondes après, on la retrouve pistolet à la main en plein braquage d’un point de retrait d’argent. Le joueur reprend la main en pleine fuite, coursée par la police. La première séquence avec Jason survient pour sa part sur un bateau, suivie d’une première mission où le joueur est amené (très) largement à utiliser son arme à feu et à esquiver les balles.
HAHAHA il a réussi à rater le tuto de GTA 6 😭 pic.twitter.com/RelSWLyi5z
Sans grande surprise, les premiers instants de ce nouvel opus transportent le joueur directement dans ce qu’il attendait : l’intrigue, le cadre, les armes… En moins d’une heure, il aura contrôlé deux personnages, une voiture, un bateau et… un hydravion avec lequel il est possible de s’amuser à faire des loopings ou de se crasher. Bref un monde où presque tout est permis dès les débuts.
Dès 11h45 heure française, mois d’une demi-heure donc avant le début des premières diffusions en direct, plus de 650 000 spectateurs de tous les pays attendaient déjà sur la plate-forme Twitch . Et le chiffre n’a cessé de monter pour dépasser le million à midi et les 2,5 millions à 12h40.
« Il y a de fortes chances que Twitch vive son plus grand record d’audience jamais enregistré », glissait au Parisien début novembre Dan Clancy, son PDG. D’après le cabinet spécialisé Sensor Tower, le jeu a été précommandé à plus de quinze millions d’exemplaires partout dans le monde.
